name: learn
description: Draft end-of-session process learnings and validated approaches for the current project's learnings.md.

interface.shortDescription: Draft reusable process learnings for review.
interface.longDescription: At the end of a working session, $learn replays what happened and drafts reusable process learnings — sequence errors, scoping errors, assumption errors, validated approaches, and known gaps — for your review before anything is written to the project's learnings.md.
defaultPrompt: Use $learn to draft this session's reusable process learnings for my review.
